description: BMS root parent and proposed gap requirements. All gap items are review status and require human approval.

requirements.title: BMS System Requirements Baseline
requirements.statement: The BMS software requirements baseline shall be allocated to SWC_BatteryManagement on ECU_BMS_Main and shall trace to the battery system/stakeholder requirements.
requirements.source: Placeholder parent injected by the hardening system
requirements.rationale: The source CSV has no system/stakeholder hierarchy. This placeholder enables traceability without inventing a stakeholder requirement.
open_issues: Placeholder system parent; replace with the real battery system/stakeholder requirement and confirm ASIL allocation.

requirements.title: Cell Voltage Sensor Loss Safe State
requirements.statement: When a cell-voltage measurement channel is invalid or lost for more than 100 ms, the BMS shall enter a safe state that inhibits charging and limits discharge power to zero.
requirements.source: Gap analysis: ISO 26262-6 fault reaction, ASPICE SWE.4
requirements.rationale: The source defines plausibility checks but not the system-level safe state for loss of a cell-voltage channel.
open_issues: 100 ms reaction time is proposed; confirm with the BMS safety analysis.

requirements.title: Contactor Weld Detection
requirements.statement: When the commanded contactor state is OPEN but the feedback indicates CLOSED for more than 100 ms, the BMS shall set a contactor-weld DTC and inhibit precharge.
requirements.rationale: The source detects a feedback mismatch but does not specify the weld-specific reaction or precharge inhibition.
open_issues: Confirm the weld-detection window and precharge inhibit behaviour.

requirements.title: Insulation Fault Reaction
requirements.statement: When the pack insulation resistance falls below the calibrated threshold, the BMS shall set an insulation fault, inhibit charging, and limit discharge power to the calibrated safe value.
requirements.rationale: Insulation monitoring is not covered by the source set but is required for a high-voltage traction battery.
open_issues: Add the insulation-monitoring requirement source and confirm the threshold/safe power values.

requirements.title: Thermal Propagation Warning
requirements.statement: When the cell temperature gradient exceeds the calibrated propagation threshold for more than 500 ms, the BMS shall set a thermal-propagation warning and request controlled shutdown.
requirements.rationale: The source detects a temperature gradient but does not define a propagation-specific warning/shutdown reaction.
open_issues: Confirm the propagation threshold and 500 ms reaction with the battery safety analysis.

requirements.title: SOC and SOH Plausibility
requirements.statement: The BMS shall validate the SOC and SOH estimates against the voltage-based and charge-integration references and shall flag a plausibility fault when the deviation exceeds the calibrated tolerance.
requirements.rationale: The source defines clamping and SOH estimation but not a cross-check/plausibility requirement for the estimates.
open_issues: Confirm the calibrated SOC/SOH plausibility tolerance and the fault reaction.

requirements.title: Cell Balancing Fault Handling
requirements.statement: When a balance relay or bleed-resistor feedback indicates a stuck-on or open circuit for more than 200 ms, the BMS shall disable balancing and set a balancing fault DTC.
requirements.rationale: The source commands balancing but does not define the fault reaction for a failed balance relay.
open_issues: Confirm the relay feedback mechanism and 200 ms detection window.

requirements.title: Diagnostic Freeze Frame and Persistence
requirements.statement: The BMS shall capture a freeze frame for each safety-relevant DTC containing pack current, pack voltage, cell voltage extrema, temperature extrema and SOC at the time of the fault, and persist it in NVM.
requirements.rationale: The source names DTCs but does not define freeze-frame content or persistence.
open_issues: Confirm the freeze-frame data set and NVM block layout.

requirements.title: Calibration Verification
requirements.statement: At startup and after a calibration update, the BMS shall verify that every safety-relevant calibration parameter is within its declared range and consistent with the battery variant.
requirements.rationale: The source exposes many calibration constants but does not require their verification.
open_issues: Define the safety-relevant calibration list, ranges and variant matrix.

requirements.title: Software and Calibration Update Integrity
requirements.statement: The BMS shall only accept authenticated and integrity-protected software and calibration updates and shall record a fault when verification fails.
requirements.source: Gap analysis: ISO 21434, UNECE R155/R156 context
requirements.rationale: A safety-critical high-voltage controller needs update integrity; the source set does not address cybersecurity.
open_issues: Develop the full ISO 21434 cybersecurity requirements; this is a placeholder.
requirements.constraint_rationale: Security constraint on the update path; verified by security review and update-integration test.

requirements.title: Battery Variant Configuration
requirements.statement: The BMS shall select cell count, capacity, chemistry, voltage limits and thermal limits from a validated battery-variant configuration.
requirements.rationale: The source assumes 96 cells and a 100 Ah pack; other variants need explicit configuration handling.
open_issues: Define the variant matrix and configuration source.
requirements.constraint_rationale: Configuration constraint; verified by variant-matrix review and end-of-line test.

requirements.title: Fault Injection and Observability
requirements.statement: The BMS shall expose test hooks to inject cell-sensor loss, contactor weld, insulation, thermal-gradient and plausibility faults and shall publish the resulting mode and DTC bitmask.
requirements.source: Gap analysis: ASPICE SWE.4, ISO 26262-6 fault injection
requirements.rationale: Verification of the safety mechanisms needs controllability and observability.
open_issues: Confirm the production-disable mechanism for the test hooks.
requirements.constraint_rationale: Verification-enabling constraint; reviewed for production isolation.
